description: This file defines the GuzzleHandler class which provides a request handler that sends PSR-7-compatible HTTP requests using Guzzle 6, including promise-based asynchronous request handling and error processing.

classes.name: GuzzleHandler
classes.description: A request handler class that sends PSR-7-compatible requests with Guzzle 6, supporting asynchronous operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a GuzzleHandler with an optional HTTP client instance.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles a PSR-7 request asynchronously, adding a user agent header and managing errors.

methods.name: parseOptions
methods.description: Parses and modifies request options, particularly handling the 'http_stats_receiver' callback.
